description: This file defines the TransactionalResourceExtension class which implements ITransactionalResourceExtension, providing methods for managing transactional resources such as CommitReadOnly, Abort, Cancel, Confirm, and Prepare, within the Orleans transaction framework.

classes.name: TransactionalResourceExtension
classes.description: A class that manages transactional resources, providing methods to control transaction lifecycle events such as commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare.

methods.name: TransactionalResourceExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializing resource factories and resource dictionary using a grain context accessor.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Commits a read-only transaction on the specified resource.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the transaction on the specified resource.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the transaction on the specified resource.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms the transaction on the specified resource.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the resource for a transaction, including access counters and transaction manager participant ID.

methods.name: GetResource
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the transactional resource associated with the given resource ID.
